title: ALS-Linked A315T and A315E Mutations Enhance beta-Barrel Formation of the TDP-43(307-319) Hexamer: A REST2 Simulation Study.
authors: Liu, Xianshi; Li, Xuhua; Qiao, Qin; Li, Fangying; Wei, Guanghong
one_liner_zh: 该研究用REST2模拟分析ALS相关TDP-43肽段六聚体的β桶形成，虽涉及蛋白寡聚与MD方法，但对象为蛋白自组装而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制关联较弱。
abstract: Pathogenic mutations of transactivation response element DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) are closely linked with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). It was recently reported that two ALS-linked familial mutants A315T and A315E of TDP-43(307-319) peptides can self-assemble into oligomers including tetramers, hexamers, and octamers, among which hexamers were suggested to form the beta-barrel structure. However, due to the transient nature of oligomers, their conformational properties and the atomic mechanisms underlying the beta-barrel formation remain largely elusive. Herein, we investigated the hexameric conformational distributions of the wild-type (WT) TDP-43(307-319) fragment and its A315T and A315E mutants by performing all-atom explicit-solvent replica exchange with solute tempering 2 simulations. Our simulations reveal that each peptide can self-assemble into diverse conformations including ordered beta-barrels, bilayer beta-sheets and/or monolayer beta-sheets, and disordered complexes. A315T and A315E mutants display higher propensity to form beta-barrel structures than the WT, which provides atomic explanation for their enhanced neurotoxicity reported previously. Detailed interaction analysis shows that A315T and A315E mutations increase inter-molecular interactions. Also, the beta-barrel structures formed by the three different peptides are stabilized by distinct inter-peptide side-chain hydrogen bonding, hydrophobic, and aromatic stacking interactions. This study demonstrates the enhanced beta-barrel formation of the TDP-43(307-319) hexamer by the pathogenic A315T and A315E mutations and reveals the underlying molecular determinants, which may be helpful for in-depth understanding of the ALS-mutation-induced neurotoxicity of TDP-43 protein.
abstract_zh: 反式激活反应元件DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）的致病性突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）密切相关。近期报道指出，TDP-43(307-319)肽段的两个ALS相关家族性突变体A315T和A315E能够自组装形成包括四聚体、六聚体和八聚体在内的寡聚体，其中六聚体被认为形成β-桶状结构。然而，由于寡聚体的瞬时性质，其构象特性及β-桶状结构形成的原子机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们通过进行全原子显式溶剂溶质回火2副本交换模拟，研究了野生型（WT）TDP-43(307-319)片段及其A315T和A315E突变体的六聚体构象分布。我们的模拟揭示，每个肽段能够自组装形成多种构象，包括有序β-桶状结构、双层β-折叠和/或单层β-折叠，以及无序复合物。A315T和A315E突变体比WT表现出更高的β-桶状结构形成倾向，这为先前报道的其增强的神经毒性提供了原子层面的解释。详细的相互作用分析表明，A315T和A315E突变增加了分子间相互作用。此外，由三种不同肽段形成的β-桶状结构通过不同的肽间侧链氢键、疏水性和芳香族堆积相互作用得以稳定。本研究证明了致病性A315T和A315E突变增强了TDP-43(307-319)六聚体的β-桶状结构形成，并揭示了潜在的分子决定因素，这可能有助于深入理解ALS突变诱导的TDP-43蛋白神经毒性。
